key_insight: Neural Transfer Unification (NTU) lets a decoder learned on smaller quantum codes transfer efficiently to larger code distances, reducing the training bottleneck for foundation decoders.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path to scalable, amortized decoder training for fault-tolerant quantum processors, especially when syndrome generation and optimization become expensive at large distances.
method: Align decoding tasks across code distances using shared algebraic structure in scalable code families.
Train on smaller codes and transfer learned knowledge to accelerate large-code decoder adaptation.
Instantiate the framework as NTU-Transformer for planar surface codes and bivariate bicycle codes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong evaluation results on planar surface codes under circuit-level noise, including [ [361,1,19] ] and transfer to [ [625,1,25] ], plus improved low-error performance on the [ [72,12,6] ] bivariate bicycle code.
watch_item: Transfer gains may depend on the chosen code family and the availability of shared algebraic structure, so portability to unrelated codes is not guaranteed.
paper_title: Efficient foundation decoders for fault-tolerant quantum computing
